source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-28

procedures.title: Ignition pulse amplifier: disassemble and check components
steps: Transistors TR1 and TR2 (see figure 20i in the manual): zero both ways in step 1 means shorted; in step 2, zero both ways means shorted and infinite both ways means open; read step 3 like step 2.
Trigger transistor TR3: judge the same way as TR1/TR2 (step 1 zero both = shorted; steps 2 and 3 zero both = shorted, infinite both = open).
Diode D1: zero both ways = shorted; infinite both ways = open.
Capacitor C1: zero both ways = shorted.
Capacitors C2 and C3: put the ohmmeter across each; zero both ways = shorted.
Resistor R1: infinite both ways = open.
Resistor R2: use a scale with 1800 ohms in or near its middle third; infinite both ways = open.
Resistor R3: use a scale with 680 ohms in or near its middle third; infinite both ways = open.
Resistor R4: use a scale with 15000 ohms in or near its middle third; infinite on either reading = open.
Resistor R5: use the lowest range; infinite on either reading = open. On some applications R5 is in the vehicle harness, not on the board.
notes: Figures 18i and 19i in the manual show the test points and the amplifier internal circuit.
